Language Movement activist Gazi Shahidullah passes away
2018-02-06T00:00:00+06:00 | Our Correspondent, Khulna
https://www.thedailystar.net/city/language-movement-activist-gazi-shahidullah-passes-away-1530514

Veteran Language Movement activist and former chairman of Khulna Municipality Gazi Shahidullah passes away at  Khulna Medical College Hospital  yesterday aged 81.

He was born on February 1, 1937 and later studied at Khulna BL college where he was elected Chatra Sangsad's president in 1955-56 and was elected chairman of the then Khulna Municipality in 1973.

His first Janaza was held at the town's Shaheed Hadis Park after Jahur Prayer. Later, he was buried at his family graveyard in Khulna city.
